versiculo.texto:
I will sing to the LORD as long as I live.

I will praise my God to my last breath!

May all my thoughts be pleasing to him,

for I rejoice in the LORD.

nosotros.descripcion:
The first time we really talked was at a birthday party. We had known each other for a while, but we had never actually spoken. That night we had a very deep conversation about faith and opened our hearts about how we felt in our walk with God. From that night on, our friendship grew, and some time later we began our relationship.

We share our love for Jesus, food, thrifting, and watching movies.

We have seen God's goodness, faithfulness, and power in our relationship. There have been very sweet moments and some quite difficult ones, and through God's hand they have shaped us and brought us closer together.

It fills us with joy to be able to share the rest of our lives together, and we would love to invite you to be part of this story.
